source.source_name: FINA RGFI — Annual Financial Statements (javna objava)
source.attribution: Izvor: FINA — Registar godišnjih financijskih izvještaja (RGFI), Otvorena dozvola.

access.note: Free registration/login on the RGFI javna objava portal. Balance sheet + income statement available as open CSV. Fuller/large-company data may need FINA's paid product.

transport.download_url: http://rgfi.fina.hr/JavnaObjava-web (CSV after login); data.gov.hr CKAN dataset

pagination.note: CSV downloads of standard documentation (bilanca + RDG). Per-company or batched depending on the portal. Confirm exact resource/columns from the FINA RGFI portal / CKAN.

snapshot.note: Persist raw CSV; map AOP positions to financial fields.

parsing.notes: oib stays string. Map RGFI AOP positions: ukupna aktiva->total_assets, kapital i rezerve->equity, ukupni prihodi->revenue, dobit/gubitak razdoblja->net_income. velicina governs which lines exist. Currency EUR since 2023 (HRK earlier) — watch the boundary.

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per razdoblje; map bilanca + RDG.
mapping_rules.matching: Clean join on OIB to the Sudski registar spine.

fixture_requirements: veliki/srednji company (full bilanca + RDG; revenue present)
company with prosječan broj zaposlenih present

live_test_plan.smoke: With FINA_RGFI login, download one company's RGFI CSV; parse ukupna aktiva + ukupni prihodi + dobit/gubitak.
live_test_plan.full: Behind FINA_RGFI_* env gate, download the javna-objava CSVs; parse AOP positions; normalize to financial_statements[]; join on OIB. For full large-company coverage evaluate the paid FINA product.

blockers: Free FINA login required for the CSV.
Open CSV emphasized for micro/small; full large-company data may need the paid FINA product.
